summary: 41-year-old woman fell 50-60 feet in the Rough Canyon Lemon Squeezer area of Bangs Canyon on Wednesday morning; Mesa County Sheriff deputies and Mesa County SAR responded around 10:20 a.m., Grand Junction Fire attempted life-saving measures but she did not survive.
location: Rough Canyon Lemon Squeezer, Bangs Canyon
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search and Rescue, Grand Junction Fire Department
notes: Date inferred: MCSO release says 'Wednesday morning'; Next Summit mirror post stamped 2024-02-22 (Thursday), so incident Wednesday = 2024-02-21.
